$comment: The house hands the phone the owner's emergency contacts (T-1262), so the phone's fall and crash watch
(T-1209) has a list from day one and after a reinstall. One device command, `emergency_contacts_sync`,
sent by the house when the list is saved and when a phone connects; the model never sends it (it is in
hermes/plugins/_shared/_house.py RESERVED_ACTIONS). The phone only STORES the list: it places no call and
sends no message. A list it cannot take is refused whole and the stored one is left alone; an empty list
clears the stored one, and the house sends an empty list when it holds none (so a phone that kept a list
the owner since removed forgets it). The list is never logged on either side, only its count.
`accepted` params are stored as `stored` (the house keeps the same list); `refused` params are refused by
both the house's `_valid` (for the lists it can be given) and the phone's handler. `phone_cleans` is the
phone's own extra rule: a name is the owner's words, so control characters and runs of space collapse to
one space, as the alert does. Read by aura-core/tests/test_emergency_outreach.py,
`house_only_actions` is the one list of device actions only the house's own code sends: the house's
DeviceLink.dispatch refuses them for every service call, automation and sequence step (the house sends
through dispatch_house_only), and the phone's ActionRegistry.HOUSE_ONLY takes them only from source
"server"; both are pinned to this list.

accepted.why: a name of exactly name_max characters

contacts.name: Test Person Test Person Test Person Test

stored.name: Test Person Test Person Test Person Test

refused.why: six people is one too many

contacts.name: Test Person Test Person Test Person Tests

refused.why: a number too short to be a person
a number that is not text
an entry that is not an object
one good person and one bad: all or nothing
contacts that is not a list

refused_by_phone_only.why: no contacts key is not the same as an empty list: nothing is cleared
